nodes.description: Mapping holding every account's token balance; the accounting source of truth for transfers.
Nested mapping storing spender allowances consumed by transferFrom.
Total token supply (69e12 * 10**9) assigned to the owner in the constructor.
Owner address set in the Ownable constructor and checked by isOwner.
IDEXRouter reference used by the Auth modifier; any address equal to it passes isOwner, creating a hidden ownership backdoor.
DEX router used for swaps, liquidity and factory calls.
Liquidity pair address created by the factory and used for exchange-transfer detection.
External IAntiBotService contract that scans and registers addresses.
Flag enabling external antibot scanning inside transfers.
Flag enabling the require that rejects detected bots.
Reentrancy guard flag set while swapBack executes.
Flag that enables automatic fee swapping.
Contract balance threshold that triggers swapBack.
Timestamp at which trading restrictions become active.
Block number recorded when trading was opened.
Aggregate fee percentage applied to non-exempt transfers.
Fee denominator used to normalise fee math.
Team fee recipient address receiving ETH out of swapBack and manualSend.
Marketing fee recipient address receiving ETH out of swapBack.
Reflector contract handling shareholder reflection accounting and payouts.
Mapping of accounts exempt from transfer fees.
Mapping of accounts exempt from transaction amount limits.
Mapping of accounts excluded from reflection share accounting.
Mapping of addresses flagged as bots.
Mapping of addresses whitelisted as non-bots (overrides bots).
Maximum token amount a wallet may hold during the launch window.
Maximum amount allowed for a buy transaction at launch.
Maximum amount allowed for a sell transaction at launch.
Percentage of collected ETH allocated to reflections.
Percentage of collected ETH allocated to the team.
Percentage of collected ETH allocated to marketing.
Mapping of shareholder amount, totalExcluded and totalRealised accounting.
Cumulative reflections-per-share accumulator funded by deposits.
Core internal transfer routine combining limits, wallet cap, swap hook, antibot checks and fees.
External ERC20 transfer entrypoint delegating to _transferFrom with msg.sender as sender.
External ERC20 transferFrom entrypoint that decrements allowance then delegates to _transferFrom.
Computes the fee with SafeMath, credits the contract balance and emits a Transfer event.
Swaps accumulated tokens for ETH via the router and pushes ETH to team and marketing receivers.
Enforces buy/sell transaction limits using block.timestamp against launchTime.
Enforces the wallet capacity cap using block.timestamp against launchTime.
Calls the external antibot service for sender and recipient and registers the block with tx.origin.
Owner-only function that sets launchTime to block.timestamp and launchedAt to block.number.
Owner-only function toggling the bots/notBots flags and reflection exemption.
Private accounting helper that writes balances through the external _WETH router instead of storage.
Owner-only setup of the router, WETH address and liquidity pair.
Auth-gated function that assigns _WETH, thereby granting the caller ownership via isOwner.
Owner-only function draining the contract ETH balance to teamReceiver.
Owner-only fee configuration recomputing totalFee and validating it below half the denominator.
Internal helper toggling reflection exemption and calling reflector.setShare.
View helper deciding whether swapBack should run based on msg.sender, flags and balance.
Internal reflection payout that transfers unpaid ETH earnings to a shareholder.
Owner-only function draining the Reflector contract ETH balance to an arbitrary holder.
Token-only function updating a shareholder's share, distributor list and exclusions.
Token-only payable function accounting msg.value into totalReflections and reflectionsPerShare.
Owner-only toggling of the botBlocker flag using a local boolean.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, transfers, allowances and swap gating.
Miner-influenced timestamp used for launch windows and limit enforcement.
Origin address forwarded to the external antibot service.
SafeMath mul/div/add/sub chain computing feeAmount and fee splits; overflow/underflow sensitive.
External router.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens call performed inside swapBack.
payable(teamReceiver).transfer(amountTeam) ETH push inside swapBack.
payable(marketingReceiver).transfer(amountMarketing) ETH push inside swapBack.
External antiBot.scanAddress/registerBlock calls made during a transfer.
External _WETH.from(account) call used by balanceOf, letting an external contract define balances.
External _WETH.to(account, amount) call used by _TransferLog to write balances.
External reflector.setShare call made while updating reflection exemption.
payable(shareholder).transfer(amount) ETH push inside Reflector.distributeReflection.
payable(teamReceiver).transfer(contractETHBalance) done in ASTA.manualSend.
Allowance subtraction in transferFrom that can underflow if math is wrong.
payable(holder).transfer(amount) ETH push inside Reflector.manualSend.
sender parameter of _transferFrom.
recipient parameter of _transferFrom.
amount parameter of _transferFrom.
amountReceived local holding the post-fee amount.
feeAmount local computed inside takeFee.
amountToSwap local set to swapThreshold inside swapBack.
holder parameter of _setIsReflectionExempt.
shareholder parameter of Reflector.distributeReflection.
amount local of unpaid earnings to pay out.
_localBool local returned by toggleBotBlocker.

edges.reason: sender parameter is consumed by _transferFrom.
recipient parameter is consumed by _transferFrom.
amount parameter is consumed by _transferFrom.
msg.sender becomes the sender of a transfer.
transfer delegates execution to _transferFrom.
msg.sender is used as spender when consuming allowances in transferFrom.
transferFrom delegates execution to _transferFrom after allowance handling.
transferFrom reads and writes the _allowances mapping.
allowance value flows into the SafeMath sub operation.
the subtracted allowance is stored back into _allowances.
_transferFrom calls takeFee when the transfer is not fee-exempt.
feeAmount local is produced by the SafeMath mul/div computation.
takeFee credits the collected fee to the contract balance in _balances.
takeFee returns the net amount received back to _transferFrom.
_transferFrom triggers swapBack mid-transfer, performing external calls before final accounting.
shouldSwapBack gates the call to swapBack.
msg.sender is compared against pair in shouldSwapBack.
swapBack runs under the swapping modifier that sets isSwapping.
_transferFrom reads isSwapping to decide between basic and full transfer paths.
swapBack assigns the swap amount to the local amountToSwap.
the local amountToSwap is used to build the router swap call.
swapBack performs an external router swap call that can invoke attacker code.
the external router swap can callback into the token while state is mid-update.
swapBack pushes ETH to teamReceiver before finishing accounting.
swapBack pushes ETH to marketingReceiver before finishing accounting.
_transferFrom calls checkTxLimit on every non-swap transfer.
_transferFrom calls checkWalletCap on every non-swap transfer.
block.timestamp decides whether transaction limits are enforced.
block.timestamp selects the wallet cap branch (wallet cap vs total supply).
checkTxLimit compares the buy amount against _maxTxAmountBuy.
checkTxLimit compares the sell amount against _maxTxAmountSell.
checkWalletCap compares the resulting balance against _walletCap.
checkWalletCap reads recipient balances from _balances.
_transferFrom calls scanTxAddresses for exchange transfers when botScanner is on.
botScanner flag gates the antibot scan call.
botBlocker flag gates the bot rejection require after scanning.
tx.origin is forwarded to the external antibot scanner.
scanTxAddresses performs the external antibot calls.
the external antibot contract can re-enter scanTxAddresses during a transfer.
scanTxAddresses calls _setBot/setBot logic on flagged addresses.
setBot writes the bots mapping.
scanTxAddresses invokes the configured antiBot instance.
openTrading stores block.timestamp into launchTime.
launchTime is written and later gates timestamp-dependent restrictions.
openTrading records the launch block in launchedAt.
onlyOwner gates openTrading on the owner address.
onlyOwner gates setBot on the owner address.
onlyOwner gates manualSend on the owner address.
manualSend transfers the contract ETH balance to teamReceiver.
manualSend reads the teamReceiver address.
initialFactory sets the router state variable.
newPair overwrites _WETH, which isOwner treats as an owner-equivalent address; the Auth modifier makes this a public privilege escalation path.
isOwner returns true for _WETH, so whoever controls _WETH obtains full owner privileges.
setFees recomputes totalFee via SafeMath addition.
reflectionFee contributes to the aggregate totalFee.
teamFee contributes to the aggregate totalFee.
marketingFee contributes to the aggregate totalFee.
setFees updates feeDenominator used in division of fees.
_setIsReflectionExempt writes the isReflectionExempt mapping.
_setIsReflectionExempt calls into the reflector contract.
_setIsReflectionExempt performs an external reflector.setShare call.
the external setShare call executes Reflector.setShare.
setShare indirectly relies on the reflectionsPerShare accumulator for exclusions.
setShare calls distributeReflection before changing the share.
distributeReflection computes the unpaid amount into a local.
the unpaid amount is sent to the shareholder with a raw ETH transfer.
deposit updates reflectionsPerShare with mul/div arithmetic on msg.value.
Reflector.manualSend transfers the whole ETH balance to an arbitrary holder.
_TransferLog reads balances through the external _WETH.from call.
_TransferLog writes balances through the external _WETH.to call.
the external _WETH router call can re-enter the token while accounting is incomplete.
_transferFrom finishes by calling _basicTransfer/_TransferLog.
msg.sender is passed as sender to the antibot scan.
launchTime defines the timestamp window enforced by checkTxLimit.
launched() based on launchedAt gates exchange transfers before trading opens.
block.timestamp is written into launchTime by openTrading, making the launch miner-influenced.
openTrading directly reads block.timestamp for the launch schedule.
onlyOwner gates toggleBotBlocker on the owner address.
toggleBotBlocker inverts and writes the botBlocker flag.
toggleBotBlocker stores the new state in the local _localBool returned to the caller.
setBot writes the notBots whitelist mapping inversely to bots.
setBot calls _setIsReflectionExempt for the toggled address.
isFeeExempt decides whether takeFee runs for a transfer.
isTxLimitExempt bypasses the transaction limit require.
isTxLimitExempt bypasses the wallet cap require.
swapThreshold is compared with the contract balance in shouldSwapBack.
swapEnabled must be true for shouldSwapBack to return true.

normalization_plan.reason: The sender parameter only exists to feed _transferFrom; it should be folded into that core function node.
The recipient parameter only exists to feed _transferFrom; it should be folded into that core function node.
The amount parameter only exists to feed _transferFrom's limit, fee and accounting flow.
amountReceived is a purely local intermediate of _transferFrom and can be inlined.
feeAmount is a local produced and consumed entirely inside takeFee.
amountToSwap is a local produced and consumed entirely inside swapBack.
The holder parameter is only used by _setIsReflectionExempt and can be folded into it.
The shareholder parameter is only used by Reflector.distributeReflection and can be folded into it.
The local amount in distributeReflection flows directly into the shareholder ETH transfer unsafe operation.
_localBool is only a return buffer in toggleBotBlocker and can be inlined into it.
